# PR #511 of kalinichenko88/craft-skills: its title, the issue it closes (#507) and its diff

## Title

fix(roadmap): print only the board settings that the project does not show as made

## Issue

# roadmap: board.sh tells the person to turn on "Auto-add to project" on each run, also when the workflow is on

**Where.** `skills/roadmap/scripts/board.sh`, the last lines: the script ends with "Two settings the API cannot make", and item 2 says to turn on "Auto-add to project" with the filter `is:issue is:open`.

**How it shows up.** The script prints item 2 on each run, also when the workflow is on. The roadmap skill tells the agent to pass both settings to the person, so the person gets a step that is already done, and checks it by hand. On 2026-11-25, on the board of this repository, the workflow was on: the GraphQL field `ProjectV2.workflows` gave `{"name":"Auto-add to project","enabled":true}`, and the two issues made before the run were on the board already, so the script added 0.

The API reads the state of a workflow (`workflows { name enabled }`), but not its filter. So the script can know when item 2 is done, except for the filter.

**What to do.**

- Before the last lines, read `workflows(first: 20) { nodes { name enabled } }` of the project.
- When "Auto-add to project" is enabled, leave item 2 out, or print it as a check of its filter only.
- Item 1, the grouping of the view, has the same defect: the API cannot set a view's grouping, but it reads it (`ProjectV2View.groupByFields`). On this repository's board, "By milestone" is grouped by Milestone already. Leave item 1 out when that view is grouped by the milestone field.
- A case in `tests/roadmap_scripts_test.sh` with a fake `gh` that returns the workflow as enabled.

**Done when** a run of `board.sh` on a project with "Auto-add to project" enabled does not tell the person to turn it on.

**Why it was out of scope here.** Found in a re-plan of the milestones, outside any task, when the person said that the setting was already on.
